mathematical_meanings: Left image: x labels the horizontal coordinate axis. Right image: x labels the horizontal coordinate axis or independent-variable direction.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at x at the positive end of its coordinate axis; the right occurrence is at x at the right end of the horizontal axis. Both use the selected notation for the same horizontal coordinate-axis role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
